verifiedBehavior: The real WPF application window opens and renders its workspaces and themes.
The floating clock shows seconds and schedules its next update one second later.
Hiding seconds reschedules the next update for the next minute boundary.
Showing seconds again restores one-second updates.

portableExecutableSmoke.behavior: Zeus.Desktop.exe opened a responsive main window and closed cleanly.

limitations: This is automated acceptance on one Windows machine, not a power or CPU benchmark across hardware.
It does not validate physical multi-monitor layouts or mixed-DPI behavior.
